sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7582 of 2023

Petitioner :- Iarar @ Israr Ahmad
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 8 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Sageer Ahmad Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned AGA.

The present petition has been filed seeking direction to the respondent authorities to conclude the fair investigation of Case Crime No. 91 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, P.S.- Nawabganj, District- Bareilly.

Submission made by the counsel for the petitioner is that sister of the informant has lost her life, but the local police is sitting tight over the matter and has not taken any Iarar @ Israr Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And 8 Others on 17 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194562530/

entities.text: Iarar @ Israr Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And 8 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 action against the named accused-persons and even neither the accused-persons have been arrested nor any charge sheet has been filed against them so far.

In view of such facts, in case, petitioner moves a representation before the S.S.P., Bareilly, within a period of one week from today, the S.S.P. Bareilly is directed to look into the matter and will pass a suitable order guiding the concerned S.H.O. within next 15 days.
With the aforesaid observations/directions, the writ petition stands disposed off.
